measured_by: <who timed it and how, e.g. 'Arjen, stopwatch, 2 sessions with first-time players'>
_how_to_fill: Fill only what you measured. Leave everything else null or delete it; nothing is required.

Times are per occurrence as you see it at the table: one move (all its steps), one card drawn, one card read and carried out. min_s = a fast, focused table; max_s = a slow, chatty table; typical_s is optional.
A category counts as provided when min_s and max_s are both filled.
sessions: real games you timed from first turn to final scoring (play_min), one entry per game.
Category definitions: 00b_output_contract.md section 7.1. Remove this _how_to_fill list or leave it; it is ignored.
